questions.title: Two Sum
questions.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
questions.constraints:
2 <= nums.length <= 10^4
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9
Only one valid answer exists.
questions.input_format:
Line 1: N (array length)
Line 2: N space-separated integers
Line 3: target integer

questions.title: Palindrome String
questions.description: Given a string S, determine whether it is a palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.
